summary: On June 9, 2026, Forward Industries filed an 8-K disclosing a non-binding indicative proposal made on June 1 to acquire all outstanding shares of Brera Holdings PLC in an all-stock transaction. No specific terms (price, premium, or timeline) were provided. The board has not yet commented; no advisors were named. The proposal is preliminary and non-binding; no certainty exists that a formal offer will be made. Investors should monitor for further disclosures or a definitive agreement; risk-arb is premature given the early stage and lack of terms.
